ServicePackage.title: ServicePackage
ServicePackage.description: Represents an AC service item with image graphic index, service name, tagline, and price in INR, managed by an authorized admin and displayed publicly on the website.

name.description: Display title of the AC service.

tagline.description: Short subtitle or description of what is included in the service.

priceInr.description: Starting service price per AC unit in INR (between 49 and 500000).

iconIndex.description: Index of the service illustration graphic (0 to 5).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the service was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the service was last updated.

CustomerMessage.title: CustomerMessage
CustomerMessage.description: Represents a direct inquiry message sent from the website and accessible to the customer or admin.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the customer who sent the message.

senderName.description: Full name of the customer sending the message.

senderEmail.description: Verified email address of the sender.

locality.description: Customer locality in Delhi or Gurugram.

acDetails.description: AC type and unit count selected by the customer.

messageText.description: Body of the message sent to Cool Bros AC Service.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent.

CustomerReview.title: CustomerReview
CustomerReview.description: Moderated customer review and star rating submitted by a signed-in user or guest customer.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reviewer, or 'guest' when submitted without sign-in.

authorName.description: Display name of the customer leaving the review.

isVerifiedUser.description: True if submitted by a Google-authenticated user with verified email, false for guest submissions.

approved.description: Moderation flag. Only reviews with approved == true are publicly readable.

locality.description: Customer locality or sector in Delhi or Gurugram.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when review was submitted.

/services/{serviceId}.description: Stores AC services and live pricing configured by the admin and publicly readable by all visitors without leaking admin email.

/messages/{messageId}.description: Stores customer inquiry messages isolated strictly to the authenticated sender or admin.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Stores moderated customer reviews. Public visitors can only read approved reviews; admins can read, approve, or delete all reviews.
